scope: Pre-bet classification for independently reviewed, straight wagers; not an odds feed or a bet-placement service
breakEvenFormula: -odds / (-odds + 100) for negative odds; 100 / (odds + 100) for positive odds

friends.note: Information only, even if mathematical EV is positive; slight-edge sublabel requires both edge and ROI criteria.

certified.note: Internal probability tier, not a guarantee of winning, independent external certification, or calibration proof.

reviewGate: No positive stake unless probability model has been independently reviewed, actual ticket odds are supplied, and both minimum actionable thresholds are met.
recordkeeping: Preserve exact offered odds, forecast version, model validation record, decision timestamp and result. Never convert retrospective forecasts to prospective locks.
